"
|                           <div>
|                             id="field.name.registration"
|                             "
"
|                             <section>
|                               id="section-18.4"
|                               "
        "
|                               <h3>
|                                 id="name-field-name-registration"
|                                 "
"
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="section-number selfRef"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#section-18.4"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "18.4. "
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="section-name selfRef"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#name-field-name-registration"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "Field Name Registration"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                 "
        "
|                               "
"
|                               <p>
|                                 id="section-18.4-1"
|                                 "
   This specification updates the HTTP-related aspects of the existing
   registration procedures for message header fields defined in "
|                                 <span>
|                                   class="reference-citation wordsize-6"
|                                   "["
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <a>
|                                     aria-expanded="false"
|                                     aria-haspopup="dialog"
|                                     class="xref whitespace-nowrap"
|                                     data-is-hash-link=""
|                                     data-state="closed"
|                                     href="#RFC3864"
|                                     type="button"
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     "RFC3864"
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- v-if -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!--  -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   "]"
|                                 ".
   It replaces the old procedures as they relate to HTTP by defining a new
   registration procedure and moving HTTP field definitions into a separate
   registry."
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="pilcrow"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#section-18.4-1"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "¶"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                               "
"
|                               <p>
|                                 id="section-18.4-2"
|                                 "
   IANA has created a new registry titled "Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP) 
   Field Name Registry" as outlined in "
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="xref"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#fields.registry"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "Section 16.3.1"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                 "."
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="pilcrow"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#section-18.4-2"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "¶"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                               "
"
|                               <p>
|                                 id="section-18.4-3"
|                                 "
   IANA has moved all entries in the "Permanent Message Header Field
   Names" and "Provisional Message Header Field Names" registries (see
   "
|                                 <span>
|                                   "<"
|                                   <a>
|                                     data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                     data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                     href="https://www.iana.org/assignments/message-headers/"
|                                     rel="noopener"
|                                     target="_blank"
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     "https://"
|                                     <wbr>
|                                       class="wordsize-wide"
|                                     "www"
|                                     <wbr>
|                                       class="wordsize-wide"
|                                     ".iana"
|                                     <wbr>
|                                       class="wordsize-wide"
|                                     ".org"
|                                     <wbr>
|                                       class="wordsize-wide"
|                                     "/assignments"
|                                     <wbr>
|                                       class="wordsize-wide"
|                                     "/message-"
|                                     <wbr>
|                                       class="wordsize-wide"
|                                     "headers/"
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                   ">"
|                                 ") with the
   protocol 'http' to this registry and has applied the following changes:"
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="pilcrow"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#section-18.4-3"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "¶"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                               "
"
|                               <ol>
|                                 class="normal type-1"
|                                 id="section-18.4-4"
|                                 start="1"
|                                 type="1"
|                                 "
               "
|                                 <li>
|                                   id="section-18.4-4.1"
|                                   "The 'Applicable Protocol' field has been omitted."
|                                   <a>
|                                     class="pilcrow"
|                                     data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                     data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                     href="#section-18.4-4.1"
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     "¶"
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                   "
"
|                                 "
          "
|                                 <li>
|                                   id="section-18.4-4.2"
|                                   "Entries that had a status of 'standard', 'experimental', 'reserved', or
   'informational' have been made to have a status of 'permanent'."
|                                   <a>
|                                     class="pilcrow"
|                                     data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                     data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                     href="#section-18.4-4.2"
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     "¶"
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                   "
"
|                                 "
          "
|                                 <li>
|                                   id="section-18.4-4.3"
|                                   "Provisional entries without a status have been made to have a status of
   'provisional'."
|                                   <a>
|                                     class="pilcrow"
|                                     data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                     data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                     href="#section-18.4-4.3"
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     "¶"
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                   "
"
|                                 "
          "
|                                 <li>
|                                   id="section-18.4-4.4"
|                                   "Permanent entries without a status (after confirmation that the
   registration document did not define one) have been made to have a status of
   'provisional'. The expert(s) can choose to update the entries' status if there is
   evidence that another is more appropriate."
|                                   <a>
|                                     class="pilcrow"
|                                     data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                     data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                     href="#section-18.4-4.4"
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     <!-- [ -->
|                                     "¶"
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                     <!-- ] -->
|                                   "
"
|                                 "
        "
|                               "

   determination of whether Last-Modified was a strong validator to guard
   against the possibility that the Date and Last-Modified values are
   generated from different clocks or at somewhat different times during the
   preparation of the response. This specification has relaxed that to allow
   reasonable discretion.

|                                 id="name-changes-from-rfc-7233"
|                                 "
"
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="section-number selfRef"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#appendix-B.5"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "B.5. "
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="section-name selfRef"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#name-changes-from-rfc-7233"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "Changes from RFC 7233"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                 "
        "
|                               "
"
|                               <p>
|                                 id="appendix-B.5-1"
|                                 "
   Refactored the range-unit and ranges-"
|                                 <wbr>
|                                   class="wordsize-10"
|                                 "specifier grammars to simplify
   and reduce artificial distinctions between bytes and other
   (extension) range units, removing the overlapping grammar of
   other-"
|                                 <wbr>
|                                   class="wordsize-10"
|                                 "range-"
|                                 <wbr>
|                                   class="wordsize-10"
|                                 "unit by defining range units generically as a token and
   placing extensions within the scope of a range-spec (other-range).
   This disambiguates the role of list syntax (commas) in all range sets,
   including extension range units, for indicating a range-set of more than
   one range. Moving the extension grammar into range specifiers also allows
   protocol specific to byte ranges to be specified separately."
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="pilcrow"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#appendix-B.5-1"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "¶"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                               "
"
|                               <p>
|                                 id="appendix-B.5-2"
|                                 "
   It is now possible to define Range handling on extension methods.
   ("
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="xref"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#field.range"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "Section 14.2"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                 ")"
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="pilcrow"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#appendix-B.5-2"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "¶"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                               "
"
|                               <p>

|                                 "
   Described use of the "
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="xref"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#field.content-range"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "Content-Range"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                 " header field
   ("
|                                 <a>
|                                   class="xref"
|                                   data-is-hyperlink=""
|                                   data-non-rfc-anchor-link=""
|                                   href="#field.content-range"
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   <!-- [ -->
|                                   "Section 14.4"
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                   <!-- ] -->
|                                 ") as a request modifier to perform a
   partial PUT.
   ("

|                                   href="#partial.PUT"
